notes.title: Quality Elevation Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="muleYHjl01w;full"][/previewyoutube]🌄 Major Elevated Terrain Update – Performance, Polish, and Pets!
Hello Wildarians!  

This update brings height to the world of Wildaria. Procedural elevated tiles in all the biomes besides Oceans break up the world with staircases to walk up them they will soon hold treasures themselves. The new starting area enemy the Oakoo, a living acorn will shoot baby acorns at you. 



We were able to fix a ton of bugs and make a lot of performance improvements, but as always please leave your feedback and bug reports in the discord or on the Wildaria.net/bugs form! Thanks



Here’s what’s new and fixed:
🏞️ World + Terrain


Implemented fully functioning elevated land generation, now integrated with POIs and miniPOIs  

 Added desert and swamp elevated tiles with support for overlay textures  

 Introduced biome-specific staircases (with destruction support)  

 Updated staircases and colliders to work properly with player, pets, and enemies  

 Improved sorting, pathing, and spawning for elevated land stairs  

 Created fallback system to prevent ocean elevation  

 Fixed elevated tilemap destruction bugs  

 Added support for item drops and projectiles on elevated surfaces  

 Improved elevated land edge cleanup and POI exclusion logic  

 Added debug menu support for elevated land coordinates  

🐾 Pets + Combat

 Made pet taming easier to balance during playtesting  

 Fixed pet riding on elevated terrain (stair sorting/layers)  

 Pets now follow you up and down stairs using Clipper subtraction for colliders  

 Fixed fast travel with pets  

 Started implementing elevated pathfinding for enemies  

 Improved enemy knockback interruption and doubled thrust impact  

 Fixed pet death-related bugs and champion pet behavior in arenas  



🛠️ Performance + Systems

 Optimized elevated tiles with SetTileBlock  

 Boosted performance of enemy health manager with singleton pattern  

 Improved player collider to reduce getting stuck  

 Fixed minimap flickering with new dungeon shader  

 Turned off velocity camera to fix scene fader visual glitches  

 Inventory overflow bug fixed (no more breaking with stacked items)  

 Fixed scene fader starting uncovered and added post-processing (kept subtle bloom only)  



🎮 UI + UX

 Added controller-specific icons for Interact, Sell Manager, pet/player abilities  

 Improved debug text sizing and spacing  

 Added “Quick Start” button (F4) to resume latest player and world from main menu  

 Added feedback to Bubble Lasso: charging effects, perfect/captured text, flashing visuals  

 Made mana bar a singleton for improved UI behavior  



🎵 Audio + Polish

 Added new Forest Day music event and Night Forest track  

 Fixed arena music, pet, and NPC behavior inconsistencies  

 Fixed chest inventory bug and missing SFX  





🌱 Misc Fixes & Tweaks

 Worked on Oakoo spritesheet and added Oakoo to the game!  

 Fixed minipois popping in/out, and improved their connection logic  

 Shrines now spawn properly again  

 Background sprite added to dungeon to fix visible tile edges  

 Fixed fade issues during weapon selection  

 Arena manager now correctly recognizes biome  

 Fixed inventory phantom items bug  

 Fixed ocean village arena blockers and dungeon key spawning issues  

 Improved aggro on more animals  

 Adjusted cactus and desert/swamp stair colliders  

 Slowed XP cap growth between levels  

 Fixed controller double-click issue  

 Added error handling for minimap out-of-bounds  

 Fixed a rare main menu worldgen crash  




Let us know what you think and keep reporting issues as we polish up more features. 

Happy Adventuring!

- Spacefudge

[previewyoutube=KBsi6YzXxRk;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Adventurers!

Yesterday Ign posted Wildaria's new Release Date Announcement Trailer. We will be releasing into Early Access in August 2025. With 6 months to go an much polish going into the game - Wildaria has entered Pre-Alpha and we are looking for PLAYTESTERS!!

If you are interested in helping playtest Wildaria please join us in discord! 

Now on to the new Update, "Quantity of Life" refers to the new minipoi system that fills out the world with Animal shrines that act as respawn points, Redwood trees, and secret treasure chests that require pet abilities to unlock. notes.title: "The First 15 Minutes" Update
notes.notes:
Hi Wildarians!

In this new First 15 Minutes Update I focused on the beginning of the game. Getting your starting weapon, starting on quests, the starting area's difficulty. I also focused on making it more of an immersive RPG, becuase I saw playtesters mistaking the game for a survival game.

[previewyoutube=bxJ4KuLk37E;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is the rest of the changelog for the update:

 Refactored Interactable Highlights to us a UI component that is stationary and provides data about the interactable. 
 Added Items to the interactables so now you need to press E to pick up items and there is no item magnetism. 
 Made most foliage not destroyable and non blockable. 
 Added new music and wizard music
 Added Trailer music to main menu, Tweaked Intro Animation timing, added particle effects to clicking the main menu flowers
 Worked on integrating a harvesting system into the interaction hightlight system. Move everything that cannot be harvested to not able to destroy.
 Added rich text coloring to all interactions and console messages, added new console messages.
 Added Starting Weapon Choice - Sword, Staff, Bow with UI Item adding to inv.
 Pause music when go back to main menu
 Added new Quest Pointer system that can point you in the direction of objects clamped to the players screen. Integrated into first quest
 Added Basic Quest Node Feature that tracks node type, location, offset for node pointer, and can update on scene change. 
 Added more Wizard quests to teach players how to pick items and tame pets, transitioned from lord to wizard quests.
 Created Fully dynamic tall grass with an array of different swaying grass blades that can vary in color, position, sway speed, and orientation
 Added starting grassland biome with radius of 160. Worked on adding rooms to buildings. Worked on quest pointer and main quest tutorial logic.\
 Added fence sprites, and wheat farm plots. 
 Finished new building interiors with rooms, added the new interiors with fading walls, doors and collders. Adjuested procedural room objects to new layouts, added new roomobjects and accesories created for the wizard tower - rugs, pots, wall hangings
 Added Water mote around starting biome making it an isle
 Created a new Starting Quest Blocker "Note", a whole new UI panel for a new quest, currently only being used to give the player an immediate objective when starting the game. Hooked into starting weapon selection and added Map M tool tip. Also added Inventory Tool tip to the lord dialogue
 Fixed the Welcome Sign bugging out when walking back and forth into the town collider. 
 Fixed the Path colliders over water for floating and regular towns (they were only detecting even numbered x,y values)



Happy Adventuring,
Spacefudge

notes.title: An Ocean Odyssey 1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi Wildarians!

[previewyoutube=jVDXkPW1__g;full][/previewyoutube]


I've been hard at work crafting Oceans for the World of Wildaria. You know I never thought I would get to add oceans, it was always a distant idea, a pipe dream. But as I started building the biome with diving mechanics and swimming. It all fell together. I think the diving mechanics with underwater combat is unique in the genre, let alone the art style. I was inspired by the California coast line growing up with Garabaldis and kelp forests and my times spent in warmer tropical waters snorkeling. The Ocean is an amazing domain, on our earth. It is taken for granted, I tried to do it justice, but it need so much more depth (literally haha).

But for now here is what is new in "An Ocean Odyssey" 1.1.1 Update for Wildaria:

 New Ocean Biomes (plus amazing new Ocean music)
 New Diving Mechanic - SPACE to dive and resurface (with bubble helmet :))
 5 new Ocean Animals - Fiddler Crab, Garabaldi, Yellow Tang, Lobster, Nudibranch
 New Floating Villages
 New Sunken Ruins
 New Beaches and shallows - and ability to add specific biome generation features with biome weight
 New Kelp Forests and Kelp edible Item
 New Coral Reefs with Sea Urchins that drop edible Uni item
 New Palm Trees and Monsterra plants on beaches
 Fixed many bugs that were as old as time




That's pretty much everything. Excited for the next Wildaria Update, it will either be a pet update or caves update. Please leave any feedback or bug reports on the indev version (demo) in the discord!

Happy Adventuring!
Spacefudge

notes.title: The Spells n' Swamps Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7Nii0RzRYJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

Wildaria has just had it's 3 year anniversary since development started, and while it is still in the "indev" stage it has come a long way to fun game to boot up and sink time into. While I know there are still bugs, I have squashed a LOT of them and improved the games performance by 30%. I hope you can spend some time playing the Demo Update and reporting any bugs you find in the discord :) 

What's New?

As the title suggests there are new Spells, Weapons, and Charge abilities for each weapon. And There are swamps... A whole new biome with the new crayfish mob, new swamp trees, new venus fly traps, new Aloe plant and much more.

Here's and exhaustive list of what is new:
